data.description:
Sylveon is a 3’03 foot quadrupedal, mammalian Pokémon covered with pale cream-colored fur with pink feet, ears, and tail. He has light blue eyes, long ears with blue interiors and thicker fur, a tiny nose, two stray tufts of fur on top of his head, and two pointed teeth which can be seen when he opens his mouth. There are two bows on his body: one at the base of his left ear and one at his neck. Each bow is pale cream with a pink center and trails a pair of ribbon-like feelers. The feelers are pale cream and end at the tips with a pink stripe, then a dark blue stripe, and then a light blue color. He has thick legs with small, three-toed paws and a fluffy, slightly curved tail. His rear is big, fat and wobbly with a tight donut shaped hole that really clenches down on whatever gets in it. He has average sized cock and balls. Sylveon's ribbon-like feelers emit a soothing aura that erases any sense of hostility, enabling him to stop fights instantly. When hunting, he swirls his feelers as a distraction while the aura weakens feelings of hostility in his prey, then he pounces on the victim. He will also wrap his feelers around a Pokémon's arm as they walk together, which allows him to read their feelings.
Sylveon is very defensive and snappy, despite his light and cute appearance. Perhaps it's because of his job, but he acts so sensitive and somewhat bratty. Still, it is somewhat easy to shut him up.
